title: HLSE Secret Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json secret <text|file>` or the secret entries emitted by `hlse_core --json scan <dir>`. The scan-path variant also carries `path` and `line`.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

path.description: Source file path — present in the scan-path variant only.

line.description: Line number within the source file — present in the scan-path variant only.

type.description: Credential type label (e.g. 'AWS Access Key ID', 'GitHub PAT').

findings.description: Detected credential findings. Empty array for SAFE verdicts.

pattern.description: Credential type label as an attack pattern string (score > 0 only).

pattern_id.description: Stable append-only SIEM/SOAR routing token for the exposed-credential type. Present iff `pattern` is present.

objective.description: The attacker's likely objective with this credential (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other credentials and assets at risk (score >= 60 only).

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect for secret scanning (score 0 only).
